description: This file contains functions and types related to managing hooks within a workspace, including loading hooks from directories, reading package manifests, resolving hook paths, and creating hook snapshots.

classes.name: HookPackageManifest
classes.description: Type representing the manifest of a hook package, including optional name and hooks array.

classes.name: LoadedHook
classes.description: Type representing a loaded hook with its associated frontmatter.

methods.name: filterHookEntries
methods.description: Filters hook entries based on inclusion criteria.

methods.name: readHookPackageManifest
methods.description: Reads and parses the package.json manifest in a directory.

methods.name: resolvePackageHooks
methods.description: Resolves hook paths from a package manifest.

methods.name: resolveContainedDir
methods.description: Resolves a directory path ensuring it is inside a base directory.

methods.name: loadHookFromDir
methods.description: Loads a hook from a directory by reading HOOK.md and associated handler files.

methods.name: loadHooksFromDir
methods.description: Scans a directory for hook subdirectories and loads hooks from them.

methods.name: loadHookEntriesFromDir
methods.description: Creates hook entries from hooks found in a directory.

methods.name: discoverWorkspaceHookEntries
methods.description: Discovers all hook entries in a workspace, including bundled, plugin, managed, and workspace hooks.

methods.name: buildWorkspaceHookSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a snapshot of eligible hooks in a workspace.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceHookEntries
methods.description: Loads hook entries with collision handling.

methods.name: readBoundaryFileUtf8
methods.description: Reads a boundary file as UTF-8 text.

methods.name: withOpenedBoundaryFileSync
methods.description: Opens a boundary file, executes a read function, and ensures the file is closed.

methods.name: resolveBoundaryFilePath
methods.description: Resolves the path of a boundary file.
